questions.question: In a triangle, one of the angles is three times the smallest and another is two times the smallest angle. Calculate the smallest angle.
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let smallest angle (say, ∠A) be a°

According to question,

⇒ ∠B = 3a°

⇒ ∠C = 2a°

Now, by angle sum property of triangle,

⇒ ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°

⇒ a + 3a + 2a = 180°

⇒ 6a = 180°

∴ a = 30°

If A is 40% less than B, then B is how much percentage more than A?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

A is 40% less than B

**CALCULATION:**

Let B be 100

A = B – 40% of B = 100 – 40% of 100 = 100 – 40 = 60

Required % = {(100 – 60)/60} × 100 = (40/60) × 100 = 66.66%

**∴ The correct answer is 66.66%.**

questions.question: The ratio of two numbers is 5 ∶ 9 and their difference is 44. What will be the smaller number among both the numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of two numbers is = 5 : 9

**Calculation:**

Let two numbers be 5a and 9a

According to question,

Difference = 44

⇒ 9a – 5a = 44

⇒ 4a = 44

⇒ a = 11

∴ Smallest number = 5a = 5 × 11 = 55

questions.question: In a mixture of 45 litres, the ratio of liquid A and liquid B is 7 ∶ 2. If 11 litres of liquid B is added to the mixture, then what will be the ratio of liquid A and liquid B in the new mixture?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of liquid A and liquid B = 7 : 2

**Calculation:**

As, Liquid A ∶ Liquid B = 7 ∶ 2

Quantity of Liquid A in 45 liters of mixture = {7/(7 + 2)} × 45 = (7/9) × 45 = 35 liters

Quantity of Liquid B in 45 liters of mixture = 45 – 35 = 10 liters

New Quantity of Liquid B = 10 + 11 = 21 liters

∴ New Ratio = 35 ∶ 21 = 5 ∶ 3

questions.question: If the population of a town increases by 25% in the first year and increases by 36% in the second year, then what is the average rate (in percentage)of increase in the population?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Increase in population

First year = 25%, Second year = 36%

**Formula used:**

Average rate of increase (in %) = (1/2) × Total increment ×** **100

**Calculation:**

Let the initial population of the town be 100.

Population after first year = 100 + 25% of 100 = 100 + 25 = 125

Population after second year = 125 + 36% of 125 = 125 + 45 = 170

Total increment = (170 – 100)/100 = 7/10

Average rate of increase (in %) = (1/2) × (7/10) × 100 = 35%

**∴ The correct answer is 35%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Calculation:**

Equivalent increase = 25 + 36 + (25 × 36)/100 = 70%

Average increase = 70/2 = 35%.

**∴ The average increase is 35%.**

questions.question: A sum of Rs 10000 becomes Rs 14641 when invested at compound interest at the yearly interest rate of 20% per annum. If the compounding is done half yearly, then for how many years was the sum invested?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum = Rs. 10000

Amount = Rs. 14641

Rate = 20% per annum = 10% per 6 month

**Calculation:**

Amount = Principal{1 + (rate/100)}time

⇒ 14641 = 10000{1 + (10/100)}time

⇒ 14641/10000 = (11/10)time

⇒ (11/10)⁴ = (11/10)time

⇒ time = 4

AS, it was compounded half yearly

∴ Actual time of investment = 4/2 = 2 years

questions.question: A person sells wheat at a profit of 30%. If he reduces its selling price by Rs. 60, then he suffers a loss of 10%. What was the initial selling price (in Rs.) of the wheat?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the cost price be Rs. y

When he had a profit,

Selling price = cost price + profit % of cost price

⇒ y + 30% × y = 1.3y

When he had a loss,

Selling price = cost price – loss% of cost price

⇒ y – 10% × y = 0.9y

According to the question,

⇒ 1.3y – 0.9y = 60

⇒ 0.4y = 60

questions.question: If two successive discounts of 30% and 10% are given, then what will be the ratio of marked price to selling price?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

First discount = 30%

Second discount = 10%

**Calculation:**

Let Marked Price will be Rs.100

Effective discount = 30% + 10% – {(30 + 10)/100}% = 37%

Selling Price = 100 – 37% of 100 = 63

Required ratio = 100 ∶ 63

**∴ The correct answer is 100 ∶ 63.**

questions.question: U, V, and W together can make a chair in 20 minutes. U and V together can make it in 25 minutes. How much time (in minutes) will W take to make the chair alone?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Time taken by U, V, and W together to make a chair = 20 min

Time taken by U and V together to make a chair = 25 min

**CALCULATION:**

Time taken by U, V, and W together to make a chair = 20 min

Time taken by U and V together to make a chair = 25 min

Let total work = LCM of 20 and 25 = 100 units

Efficiency of U, V, and W together = 100/20 = 5 units/min

Efficiency of U and V together = 100/25 = 4 units/min

Efficiency of W = 5 – 4 = 1 unit/min

**∴ Time taken by W to make a chair alone = 100 × 1 = 100 min**

questions.question: Two trains are moving in opposite directions with the same speed. If the length of each train is 144 metres and they cross each other in 9 seconds, then what is the speed (in km/hr) of each train?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of each train = 144 m

Time to cross each other = 9 sec.

**Calculation:**

Let speed of each train be a km/hr

Total distance covered = length of both trains = 144 + 144 = 288 m

Relative speed of trains = distance/time = 288/9 = 32 m/sec = 32 × (18/5) = 115.2 km/hr

Also,

Relative speed = a + a

⇒ 115.2 = 2a

∴ a = 57.6 km/hr

questions.question: If the length of one side and the diagonal of a rectangle are 10 cm and 26 cm respectively, then find its perimeter (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diagonal = D = 26 cm

Length = L = 10 cm

width = B = ?

**Formula used:**

Perimeter of rectangle = 2(L + B)

D² = L² + B²

where D → diagonal of a rectangle

L → Length of a rectangle

B → Breadth of a rectangle

**Calculation:**

⇒ D² = L² + B²

⇒ 26² = 10² + B²

⇒ B² = 676 – 100

⇒ B² = 576

⇒ B = 24

**∴ Perimeter of rectangle = 2(10 + 24) = 68 cm**

questions.question: ∆DEF is right angled at E. If ∠F = 45°, then find the value of (tanD - √3/2).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠E = 90° and ∠F = 45°

**Concept used:**

Sum of all angles of a triangle = 180∘

tan 45∘ = 1

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8935d9d4ff18b5371fab704b2654bfd7ae34fc11c088c960777befb97b9acf31.png] 

By angle sum property of triangle,

∠D = 180° - (∠E + ∠F) = 180° - (90° + 45°) = 45°

**∴ tan D - (√3/2) = tan 45° - (√3/2) = 1 - (√3/2) = (2 - √3)/2**
